resolution_rule: A ticket is resolved when a draft on the board clearly tells the requester what will happen and when (or that it can't be done) and nothing it depends on is still pending human approval.

tickets.subject: Bulldog tee
tickets.outcome: Size S tee was out of stock (0 on hand). The only apparel vendor was blocked by overdue invoice 501, so the invoice was paid ($840) and a 1-unit restock PO was approved ($8). Tauhid gets a draft saying size S is out of stock, the earliest estimated arrival is September 5, 2026, and sizes M/L/XL are available now as alternatives (no automatic substitution).

final_customer_draft.subject: Update: your CC-TEE-WHITE size S request

agent_contributions.boss: Read the ticket and linked invoice 501, sent Inventory and Accounting off in parallel, then Customer Service; held the ticket at waiting_on_approval twice, and resolved it once the invoice and PO were paid and the customer draft gave a date.
agent_contributions.inventory: Confirmed CC-TEE-WHITE S had 0 on hand (short 1) with M 5 / L 3 / XL 2 available; found Bulldog Print Co (apparel reprint, 5-day lead) blocked by open invoice 501; consulted Accounting about the invoice and, after it was paid, handed Accounting the PO details; gave Customer Service the customer-safe timing.
agent_contributions.accounting: Checked cash ($3,400) and requested approval #1 to pay invoice 501 ($840); after payment prepared PO #3 for 1 tee at $8 (unit cost); on the last follow-up recognised PO #3 was already paid and did not duplicate it.
agent_contributions.customer_service: Consulted Inventory before every draft; wrote 3 customer drafts (ids 1, 5, 11). The privacy guard refused 5 attempts that mentioned an 'approval'; each was rewritten without internal details.

human_approvals.what: Pay invoice 501 (Bulldog Print Co rush reprint, 3 days overdue)

tickets.subject: Rent due
tickets.outcome: Rent notice verified against lease 1 ($2,400 due 2026-09-02, 2 days from the desk date). Rent was paid with human approval and the landlord draft confirms the payment. Paying rent moves the lease's next_due to 2026-10-02 by design; Facilities then read that as a discrepancy with the notice and flagged it in the landlord draft (a wording issue to fix, not a real disagreement).

final_landlord_draft.subject: Chapel Street shop rent notice — lease timing clarification

agent_contributions.boss: Read the ticket and linked lease, delegated the whole job to Facilities, resolved after the rent request was paid and a landlord draft existed.
agent_contributions.accounting: Consulted directly by Facilities (not the boss); checked cash and prepared rent payment request #2 for $2,400.
agent_contributions.facilities: Verified the notice against lease 1 and cash, asked Accounting to prepare the rent request, and wrote two landlord drafts (ids 3 and 7).

human_approvals.what: Pay rent for lease 1 (Chapel Street shop)

tickets.subject: Bulk hoodie discount
tickets.outcome: Yale AI Club asked for 20 size-M hoodies at a bulk discount; only 8 were on hand. A 12-unit restock PO ($264) was prepared but denied by the human (checking had $152-160). The boss set the discount at $46.40 each (20% off the $58 list, above the $22 cost). The Club gets a draft offering 8 hoodies now for $371.20 and saying the other 12 cannot be supplied right now, with no restock date promised.

final_customer_draft.subject: Update: Bulk hoodie request for 20 size-M hoodies

agent_contributions.boss: Sent pricing to Accounting first, then Inventory and Customer Service; chose the 20% discount ($46.40) from Accounting's options; held at waiting_on_approval for PO #4, then resolved after the denial with the 8-unit offer.
agent_contributions.inventory: Confirmed 8 on hand / short 12 and that Bulldog Print Co could ship (invoice 501 already paid, 5-day lead); asked Accounting to prepare the 12-unit PO; gave Customer Service customer-safe availability.
agent_contributions.accounting: Consulted Inventory on stock before pricing; ran check_margin on 5 price points (0-30% off) for the 8 deliverable units; prepared PO #4 (12 × $22 = $264) and flagged that cash ($160) could not cover it.
agent_contributions.customer_service: Consulted Inventory and Accounting; wrote 2 customer drafts (ids 9 and 13). Draft 9 was saved without a ticket id, so the board couldn't link it (fixed after this run: drafts now get the ticket id automatically). One attempt was refused by the privacy guard for mentioning an 'approval'.

human_approvals.cash_effect: none (denied; it would have overdrawn checking: $152 < $264)
